كَدُودٌ A man who toils, or works, laboriously, so as to fatigue himself. (A.) ―
-b2- (tropical:) A she-camel whose milk is not obtained without labour, or exertion. (A.) بِئْرٌ كَدُودٌ (tropical:) A well of which the water is not obtained without labour, or exertion, (S, A, L, K,) and difficulty, or trouble. (TA.) ―
-b3- (tropical:) Tenacious; niggardly: (K, but omitted in some copies:) one from whom benefits are not obtained without difficulty. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
